title: Learning consequences family bound
statement: Let $t>0$ be a rational influence bound and let $0<\varepsilon\leq 1/2$ be a rational learning parameter. If $d$ is the learning consequences degree and $c$ is the learning consequences coordinate cap for these parameters, the family bound is $(d+1)(c+1)^d$.
caveat: The supplied snippet does not define the degree or coordinate cap beyond their references to other omitted definitions.
